name: Looseleaf (shadcn/ui, drawn by hand)
summary: Open-source React + Tailwind v4 + Radix component library and shadcn registry where every component looks hand-drawn on paper. 123 accessible components with the same parts, props and data-slot names as shadcn/ui, 61 blocks, 160 icons, 48 doodles, 88 stickers/stamps, a pencil mascot and the Kevin Sans typeface, all drawn in code as seeded SVG.

access.notes: MIT covers code, art and the Kevin Sans font; bundled IBM Plex Mono is SIL OFL 1.1.

procedure: Add components or blocks: npx shadcn@latest add @looseleaf/button (or @looseleaf/login-01, @looseleaf/looseleaf for the theme).
Wrap your app in InkProvider; components land in your repo as source. Or clone github.com/kevintngo/looseleaf.

verdict.why: Complete, MIT (code + art + font), drop-in shadcn registry that works today; strong launch post (15.8k views, 422 bookmarks). Repo is brand new (created 2026-11-01, 5 stars) so maturity is unproven.

image.alt: Looseleaf banner: hand-drawn tabs, switch, slider and buttons on a paper card beside the pencil-stub mascot
